# TinkerFeed

> TinkerFeed is for Indian creators and influencers who want comment-to-DM, follow-before-link and affiliate link delivery working for them. We publish tool rankings in rupees, setup guides and niche playbooks.

TinkerFeed is part of the Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd publishing network. Socialfeed Technology Pvt Ltd also builds Tadlo AI, which appears in our rankings. Full disclosure: https://tinkerfeed.in/disclosure/
